title: Thread pool exhaustion causing request queue buildup
symptoms: Logs: concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor: thread pool exhausted. Request processing queue depth: 5000. P99 response time: 45s. Logs showing requests waiting 30+ seconds before any processing begins. Error rate steady at 25% from timeouts.
root_cause: The thread pool was configured with max_workers=10. Each thread was blocked waiting on a slow third-party geolocation API that averaged 12s response time. All 10 threads were permanently occupied waiting for geolocation responses, with new requests queuing indefinitely.
fix_applied: 1. Set geolocation API timeout to 2s with fallback to IP country lookup. 2. Implemented async geolocation calls using asyncio.gather. 3. Added in-memory geolocation cache with 1-hour TTL. 4. Increased thread pool to max_workers=50 as interim. 5. Added thread pool queue depth monitoring.
